Travel

Choose an available destination on the travel map.

Routes and destinations open as you explore and complete quests. You can return to camp between trips.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Global map

You are currently in the "Global map". This is an overview of the island your character is on. It shows what Game zones are available (their borders are marked with a yellow frame). A zone becomes "available" if your character visits it at least once, or if he receives a quest to complete there.

Your character's current position is indicated with a "floating" vertical arrow.

You can rotate the Global Map in any direction you wish. The buttons at the bottom right of the screen control this.

The name of the island and the game time are shown in the upper-left corner of the screen. In the lower-left corner there's a "camp entrance" button. Click on this to see what items you have obtained, or to change your characters' weapons and armor, take on new items etc.

Game zones

The different Game zone screens show what quests you need to complete in each zone, and the approximate location of the quest. The quests themselves are displayed with special symbols.

If you place your cursor on a zone, its name will appear in the upper-right corner of the screen, followed by a list of all quests which are still active in that zone.

To get more detailed information on the quests you need to complete in a given zone just click on the zone itself. A "Quests Screen" for the zone will appear.

Note: an island's map shows only surface areas. The subterranean Game zones are marked either as separate areas or with dotted lines on the ground.

Available zones

The Global map shows only the zones currently available to your character, and differentiated by colors.

Zones in which you have completed a key quest ("explored" zones) are marked with a darker color. Your characters can bypass skip through these "explored" zones by simply clicking on the destination zone. If several such "explored" zones are adjacent and have connecting Transfer areas, you can bypass them all.

Note: you are not required to complete all available quests within a zone or kill all enemies there in order to make it an "explored" zone.

Zones which are available but not yet "explored" are marked with a lighter color. If you must pass through such a zone in order to complete your current quest, your characters will actually have to enter it and walk all the way through to their destination. You cannot bypass "unexplored" zones.

"Base"

A "base" (whether it be a village or a city) is displayed on the Island Map with a special symbol (either with gates or a building). You have at least one "base" available on every island. If the zone containing a "base" is "explored", you can enter the base directly from the Global Map. Otherwise your character will have to walk to the base.

Note: when you leave a base you always go right to the Global Map.
